init.title: 🎬 Initialize Project
init.message: Run `lv devcycle run init` to bootstrap your project structure.

scaffold-ready.title: 🏗️ Ready to Scaffold
scaffold-ready.message: Initialization complete! Run `lv devcycle run scaffold --feature <name>` to generate your first feature.

test-after-features.title: 🧪 Test Your Changes
test-after-features.message: Feature implementation detected. Run `lv devcycle run test` to validate your code.

validate-before-deploy.title: ✅ Validate Before Deploy
validate-before-deploy.message: Run `lv devcycle run validate` before deployment to ensure quality gates pass.

resume-available.title: ⏯️ Resume Available
resume-available.message: Incomplete DevCycle detected. Run `lv devcycle resume` to continue from checkpoint.

mcp-connection.title: 🔌 MCP Connection Issue
mcp-connection.message: MCP server not responding. Try `lv tools restart` or check `.vscode/mcp.json`.

config-invalid.title: ⚙️ Configuration Error
config-invalid.message: Invalid configuration detected. Run `lv config validate` or reset with `lv config reset`.

artifact-validation.title: 📦 Artifact Validation Failed
artifact-validation.message: Check artifact syntax with `lv artifact validate --verbose`. Common issues: missing frontmatter, invalid YAML.

checkpoint-conflict.title: 💾 Checkpoint Conflict
checkpoint-conflict.message: File conflicts detected. Stash changes with `git stash` before restoring checkpoint.

git-state.title: 📝 Git State Issue
git-state.message: Uncommitted changes blocking operation. Commit or stash changes first.

new-files.title: 📄 New Files Detected
new-files.message: New files created. Consider running `lv devcycle run test` to add test coverage.

docs-outdated.title: 📚 Documentation May Be Outdated
docs-outdated.message: Code changes detected without doc updates. Run `lv devcycle run docs` to regenerate.

long-running.title: ⏱️ Long Session Detected
long-running.message: Consider committing your progress. Run `git add -A && git commit -m 'wip: progress'`.

dashboard.title: 📊 Use the Dashboard
dashboard.message: Run `lv dashboard` in a separate terminal for real-time monitoring.

dry-run.title: 🔍 Preview with --dry-run
dry-run.message: Use `--dry-run` flag to preview DevCycle actions before executing.

doctor.title: 🩺 Regular Health Checks
doctor.message: Run `lv doctor` periodically to catch issues early.
